title: Custom Entity Type Schema
description: A definition of a custom entity types that can be used in the Query Tool

_version.description: FQL query version, used for migrations

owner.description: A UUID identifying entity type owner

shared.description: Denotes if the entity type is shared (true) or private (false)

createdAt.description: The creation timestamp of the entity type

updatedAt.description: The update timestamp of the entity type

isCustom.description: Discriminator field to distinguish custom entity types from system entity types

name.description: The unique name of entity type like User, Loan, Item, etc.

description.description: A description of the entity type

labelAlias.description: The identifier used for a localized label/name for this entity.

private.description: This flag denotes whether the entity type is private or not. Private entity types cannot be accessed by users for querying.

crossTenantQueriesEnabled.description: Indicates if this entity type supports cross-tenant queries

groupByFields.description: Ordered list of fields used in the GROUP BY clause for this entity type

requiredPermissions.description: List of permissions required to query this entity type

filterConditions.description: Filter conditions to be included in the WHERE clause of this entity type

additionalEcsConditions.description: Additional conditions to be included in the WHERE clause of this entity type in ECS environments

deleted.description: Indicates if this entity type is deleted

usedBy.description: List of modules that use this entity type

description.description: A description of the entity type

entityTypeColumn.title: Entity Type Column Schema
entityTypeColumn.description: A definition of the entity type column

visibleByDefault.description: Indicates if the column should be shown by default when the entity is viewed.

isCustomField.description: Indicates if the column belongs to the custom field.

isIdColumn.description: Indicates if the column is part of the unique identifier for this entity type

essential.description: Indicates if a column is crucial to the definition of an entity type

joinsTo.description: A set of columns which this column may be joined to

originalEntityTypeId.description: [Internal only, not for definitions] The simplest entity type that this column is derived from

maxColumnWidth.description: The maximum width of the column when displayed in the UI

entityTypeDefaultSort.title: Default sort criteria for an entity type
entityTypeDefaultSort.description: A definition of default sort criteria for an entity type

columnName.description: Name of the column using which entity type has to be sorted

direction.description: Direction of the sort (Ascending or Descending)

entityTypeSource.title: Entity Type Source
entityTypeSource.description: Definition for an entity type source, which provide a set of fields and can be joined with other sources

type.description: Type of source. Valid values are db, entity-type

alias.description: Alias of this source to be used in query/later joins

name.description: Name of this source. If set, this will override any source name translations

joinedViaEntityType.description: [Internal use only, should not be included in definitions] The owning entity's alias, if this source's joining is handled by a parent entity in a cross-entity join

order.description: Order of the inherited fields from this source, relative to the fields from other sources. Defaults to 1073741823 (INT_MAX/2)

field.title: Source/query column details
field.description: Properties for sourcing/querying a column or nested property

dataType.description: The data type for this field.

labelAlias.description: A pre-localized identifier used to label/name this column.

queryable.description: Indicates whether this column can be used in a query.

queryOnly.description: Indicates whether this column can be used for querying only. If true, the column can be used in a query but cannot be included in results.

source.description: Reference to the root entity type column, from where the values of this column are sourced.

valueSourceApi.description: Configuration defining where the available values for a column can be accessed

valueGetter.description: Configuration defining how to fetch values of this column from the underlying datasource.

filterValueGetter.description: Configuration defining how to filter values of this column from the underlying datasource when indexed values aren't very user-friendly.

idColumnName.description: Name of the corresponding ID column, if this column contains the value of an ID.

valueFunction.description: Configuration defining how to transform a static value for comparison with values produced by the filterValueGetter. This is useful when the filterValueGetter does extra processing that is not visible to the user. The static value can be referenced with ':value'

hidden.description: Indicates if the field is hidden in UI

values.description: Array of values for this column

ecsOnly.description: Indicates if the field is available only in ECS environments

validated.description: Indicates if the field values are validated against a predefined format or set of values

localizeForExports.description: Indicates if the field values should be localized when exported (e.g., translating enum values or formatted values for exports)

defaultValue.description: Default value for this field if none is provided

availableOperators.description: The operators available for this field when building queries. When set, this overrides the default operator set for the data type. When absent, the default operators for the data type are used.

join.title: Definition of a possible field join
join.description: A listing of a way for a field to join to another

targetId.description: The ID of the target entity type

targetField.description: The field on the target entity type

type.description: Type of join expression (e.g. custom, equality-simple, equality-cast-uuid)

joinDirection.description: Direction of the join, from the perspective of :this JOIN :target (e.g. inner, left, right)

private.description: This flag denotes whether the entity type is private or not. Private entity types cannot be accessed by users for querying.

sourceColumn.title: Source of an entity type column
sourceColumn.description: Source of an entity type column, from where the values for the column can be derived

entityTypeId.description: A UUID identifying the source entity type

type.description: Name of the source type. Possible values: entity-type, fqm. Default: entity-type

name.description: Name of the source within the source type (e.g., 'currency')

valueSourceApi.title: Value source API config
valueSourceApi.description: Configuration for a column's value source API, where the available values can be accessed

path.description: Relative path to the FOLIO module API endpoint that can provide the available column values. Example: 'material-types'

valueJsonPath.description: JsonPath defining how to access the values provided by the API

labelJsonPath.description: JsonPath defining how to access the labels for the values provided by the API

queryParams.description: Map of query parameters to be passed to API endpoint

value.description: The actual value that will be used in the query

label.description: The user-friendly name used in dropdowns, etc. If the label is not provided the value will be used instead.
